batch: September 14, 2026 New folder county board agenda review
methods: Verified SHA-256, byte size, PDF metadata and page count for both supplied PDFs.
Rendered and visually inspected all four pages in source order, including headings, agenda tables, footers, meeting notices and accessibility language.
Checked native text page-by-page. Text was usable on all pages; OCR was not required and no page was unreadable.
Classified the records by actual contents rather than filenames. These are two-page Wexford County Board meeting agenda notices, not minutes, resolutions, permits, DMRs or environmental measurements.

Compared the supplied hashes and agenda content with the public catalog; neither file is an existing public asset. They were retained as reviewed provenance but not promoted because they contain no substantive environmental record or attached Wexford evidence.
